facts.text: The Hard Deck is on me tonight. Try not to break anything, Pete.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Penny's words, but it is not a line from the film. Fine as a note in her voice, since she owns the Hard Deck.
facts.fix: The Hard Deck is on me tonight. Try not to break anything, Pete.

fix_note.text: The Hard Deck is on me tonight. Try not to break anything, Pete.

facts.why: The strike team calls itself Dagger in the transcript (Dagger-1 to Dagger-4), so a Dagger squad name is true.

facts.text: Phone on the bar means you're buying the round.
facts.why: At the Hard Deck the rule is that putting a phone on the bar means you buy the next round, and Maverick gets caught by it.
facts.fix: Penny rings the bell on anyone who welches on a tab.

vibe.verdict: The Hard Deck bar and Rooster's piano nod are great, but food and rules are partly made up.
